描述_EN: scrabble trickster has been controversial among traditional scrabble players, and particularly with the north american scrabble players association which runs annual tournaments, for allowing players to use proper nouns, something that has been outlawed since the original version was created. scrabble was first manufactured in 1948, and gameplay involved taking turns to form words from letter tiles in a crossword format. these include instructions such as "steal your opponent's last score", "spell a word anywhere on the board" or "spell a word backwards". for this reason, the north american copyright holder, hasbro inc., has never released it in that territory. this version has the addition of new markings on the classic board, which give the player a chance to use a 'trickster' card. this is an updated version of the classic scrabble board game format, retitled scrabble trickster.
描述_ZN: 拼字技巧在传统的拼字游戏玩家中一直有争议，特别是在举办年度锦标赛的北美拼字游戏玩家协会中，因为它允许玩家使用专有名词，而这是自原始版本创建以来一直被禁止的。 拼字游戏最早制造于1948年，游戏玩法是轮流用字母牌组成单词，以填字游戏的形式进行。 其中包括诸如 "偷取你的对手的最后得分"、"在棋盘上的任何地方拼出一个单词 "或 "倒过来拼出一个单词 "等指示。 由于这个原因，北美版权持有人，哈斯布鲁公司，从未在该地区发行过该游戏。 这个版本在经典棋盘上增加了新的标记，使玩家有机会使用 "诡计 "牌。 这是经典拼字棋游戏格式的更新版本，改名为拼字诀。
